dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「行ってらっしゃいませ……」
dialogues.en: "Hey, hey! Don't ignore me like you didn't hear me at all."
dialogues.text: "Hey, hey! Don't ignore me like you didn't hear me at all."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「さて、と。行きますか」
dialogues.en: He grabs my shoulder and I reluctantly turn around.
dialogues.text: He grabs my shoulder and I reluctantly turn around.

dialogues.jp:
春の温かな空気を肺いっぱいに吸い込み、俺は
学園へと向かう。
dialogues.en:
"Why are you standing in the middle of the road in the
morning? I thought you were a beggar."
dialogues.text:
"Why are you standing in the middle of the road in the
morning? I thought you were a beggar."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「いようっ！　今日もいい天気だなっ」
dialogues.en:
"I don't have a lot of money, so if you think I am a beggar
and want to give me some coins, I'll accept them."
dialogues.text:
"I don't have a lot of money, so if you think I am a beggar
and want to give me some coins, I'll accept them."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「こらこら。ナチュラルに無視するな」
dialogues.en: "I was just joking with you."
dialogues.text: "I was just joking with you."

dialogues.jp: がしりと肩を掴まれ、しぶしぶ振り返る。
dialogues.en:
I keep walking along the road strewn with cherry blossom
petals, and Suginami walks next to me.
dialogues.text:
I keep walking along the road strewn with cherry blossom
petals, and Suginami walks next to me.

dialogues.jp:
「お前は何で朝っぱらから、この道に突っ立っ
　てるんだ？　道路標識にでもなったつもり
　か？」
dialogues.en: "So? You want to talk about that again, huh?"
dialogues.text: "So? You want to talk about that again, huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「いや、こんな車の通らないところで道路標識
　になる必要もあるまい」
dialogues.en:
"Yes! You're reading my mind, man! I'm happy to have you as
my friend."
dialogues.text:
"Yes! You're reading my mind, man! I'm happy to have you as
my friend."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「真面目に答えるなっての」
dialogues.en: "Okay...... Then II'll tell you."
dialogues.text: "Okay...... Then II'll tell you."

dialogues.jp:
舞い散った桜を踏みしめ、さくさくと進む。杉
並は、その横に並んだ。
dialogues.en:
"It was...... yes, it was a very hot summer. It was so hot
that you could never eat an ice-cream without letting it
melt......"
dialogues.text:
"It was...... yes, it was a very hot summer. It was so hot
that you could never eat an ice-cream without letting it
melt......"

dialogues.jp: 「で？　また、例の話か？」
dialogues.en:
"I was walking when I found a magazine on a road. The cover
was all torn and showing an objectionable photograph of a
beautiful half-naked woman."
dialogues.text:
"I was walking when I found a magazine on a road. The cover
was all torn and showing an objectionable photograph of a
beautiful half-naked woman."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「おお！　話の早い友を持って、俺は幸せだぞ、
　朝倉！」
dialogues.en:
"I'm mature enough now to ignore it or probably give it a
disgusted look to it like I'm looking at you now, but I was
young at the time."
dialogues.text:
"I'm mature enough now to ignore it or probably give it a
disgusted look to it like I'm looking at you now, but I was
young at the time."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「そうか……ならば聞かせてやろう」
dialogues.en:
"It was a mixed feeling of curiosity, embarrassment, guilt,
and lust, and they ran around inside my body and......"
dialogues.text:
"It was a mixed feeling of curiosity, embarrassment, guilt,
and lust, and they ran around inside my body and......"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「あれはな……そう、とても暑い、早食いちゃ
　んぴょんでもなければ、アイスを溶けずには
　食べられない、そんな夏の事だった……」
dialogues.en:
"Hey, I have no idea what you're talking about. You better
stop talking or I'll punch your nose to stop you."
dialogues.text:
"Hey, I have no idea what you're talking about. You better
stop talking or I'll punch your nose to stop you."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「道を歩いていた俺は、一冊の雑誌を見つけた。
　ああ、表紙はぼろぼろにすり切れいかにもい
　かがわしいグラビアが見え隠れする雑誌だ」
dialogues.en: "So..., about Sagisawa-san......"
dialogues.text: "So..., about Sagisawa-san......"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「今の俺なら、ちょうど杉並を目にするような
　｛あんばい／塩梅｝で、そのままスルーしただろう。だが、
　あの頃の俺は青かった」
dialogues.en:
Shit... I wasn't even close to the funny part of the
story...
dialogues.text:
Shit... I wasn't even close to the funny part of the
story...

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「好奇心と羞恥心。罪悪感と欲望。そういった
　ごちゃごちゃの感情が混ざり合った熱血が、
　身中をぐるぐると巡り──」
dialogues.en:
"Her cat ears are actually real? They weren't accessories
after all? Are they still on her head?"
dialogues.text:
"Her cat ears are actually real? They weren't accessories
after all? Are they still on her head?"

dialogues.jp:
オチもなく、話はなだらかにシフトした。
ちっ……。
dialogues.en:
"Yeah, I think so. At least I haven't seen her without them
yet."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah, I think so. At least I haven't seen her without them
yet."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「あのネコ耳は、実は飾りだったなんてことは
　なく、今もきちんと付いているのか？」
dialogues.en: "Really... So she is real......"
dialogues.text: "Really... So she is real......"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「まあな。少なくとも俺は、あれが外れている
　ところを見た事がない」
dialogues.en: "Asakura, I found a very interesting flyer yesterday."
dialogues.text: "Asakura, I found a very interesting flyer yesterday."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「そうか、彼女、本物だったのか……」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp:
杉並は鞄をごそごそとあさると、一枚の紙切れ
を渡してきた。
dialogues.en:
Suginami rummages through his bag and hands me a piece of
paper.
dialogues.text:
Suginami rummages through his bag and hands me a piece of
paper.

dialogues.jp: 「何だ？」
dialogues.en: "What is this?"
dialogues.text: "What is this?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「まあ、読んでみろ」
dialogues.en: "Read it first."
dialogues.text: "Read it first."

dialogues.jp: 足は｛ゆる／緩｝めず、目だけを紙に落とす。
dialogues.en: I keep walking as I start to read.
dialogues.text: I keep walking as I start to read.

dialogues.jp:
「プロキシマからの毒電波について。その傾向
　と対策。｛のうずい／脳髄｝は物を考える｛ところ／処｝に｛あら／非｝ず……？」
dialogues.en:
"A movement and the countermeasures for the poison electric
wave from Proxima. The Ecephalon in the brain is not where
we used to think......?"
dialogues.text:
"A movement and the countermeasures for the poison electric
wave from Proxima. The Ecephalon in the brain is not where
we used to think......?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「おっと悪い。そいつは、別件だった」
dialogues.en: "Oops. That's the wrong one."
dialogues.text: "Oops. That's the wrong one."

dialogues.jp: ひょいっとチラシが持っていかれる。
dialogues.en:
He quickly takes the paper from my hand. ......Is that what
he usually reads?
dialogues.text:
He quickly takes the paper from my hand. ......Is that what
he usually reads?

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「おお、こっちだこっち」
dialogues.en: "Oh, this one."
dialogues.text: "Oh, this one."

dialogues.jp: そう言って、別のチラシを渡してくる。
dialogues.en: He gives me another piece of paper.
dialogues.text: He gives me another piece of paper.

dialogues.jp:
「今度は何だよ。えーと……？　“猫を探して
　います”……？」
dialogues.en:
"What's next? Let me see......? 'I'm looking for my
cat'......?"
dialogues.text:
"What's next? Let me see......? 'I'm looking for my
cat'......?"

dialogues.jp:
「お前な、こういうの｛は／剥｝がすなよ。きっと、飼
　い主はワラをも｛つか／掴｝む気持ちで──」
dialogues.en:
"You're supposed to leave these notes where they are. The
person who's looking for this cat must be desperate......"
dialogues.text:
"You're supposed to leave these notes where they are. The
person who's looking for this cat must be desperate......"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「名前のところを読んでみろ。猫の」
dialogues.en: "Read the name of the cat."
dialogues.text: "Read the name of the cat."

dialogues.jp:
視線を落とし、ざっと文面を改める。性別や種
別、年齢などが並んでいて……。
dialogues.en:
I look at the paper again and read briefly what it says
about the age, sex, and kind of the cat......
dialogues.text:
I look at the paper again and read briefly what it says
about the age, sex, and kind of the cat......

dialogues.jp: 「名前は……“頼子”？　頼子だって？」
dialogues.en: "Its name is......'Yoriko'? ...Yoriko?"
dialogues.text: "Its name is......'Yoriko'? ...Yoriko?"

dialogues.jp:
ぴたっと足が止まる。すうっと、周囲の学生の
ざわめきが遠くなった。
dialogues.en:
I stop walking in surprise. The noise of the other students
around me starts to fade away.
dialogues.text:
I stop walking in surprise. The noise of the other students
around me starts to fade away.

dialogues.jp: 頼る……子……頼る……子……。
dialogues.en: Yo-Ri-Ko...... Yo-Ri-Ko......
dialogues.text: Yo-Ri-Ko...... Yo-Ri-Ko......

dialogues.jp:
何度も視線を往復させ、それがやはり“頼子”
である事を確認する。
dialogues.en:
I read the name again and again to find out that it really
says Yoriko.
dialogues.text:
I read the name again and again to find out that it really
says Yoriko.

dialogues.jp: 「おいおい、これは……」
dialogues.en: "Hey, hey, this is......"
dialogues.text: "Hey, hey, this is......"

dialogues.jp: 杉並とチラシ、その二つに交互に目を向けた。
dialogues.en: I look back and forth between Suginami and the paper.
dialogues.text: I look back and forth between Suginami and the paper.

dialogues.jp: 「こりゃ、一体……」
dialogues.en: "Oh my god......"
dialogues.text: "Oh my god......"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「何だ、お前も意外そうな顔してるんだな」
dialogues.en: "You look surprised."
dialogues.text: "You look surprised."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「意外というか……」
dialogues.en: "Surprised......?"
dialogues.text: "Surprised......?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「お前の事だから、また俺に隠していたんだと
　思っていたんだがな」
dialogues.en: "I thought you knew about it and were hiding it from me."
dialogues.text: "I thought you knew about it and were hiding it from me."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……隠す？　何の事だ？」
dialogues.en: "......Hide it from you? What are you talking about?"
dialogues.text: "......Hide it from you? What are you talking about?"

dialogues.jp:
杉並の顔を見る。川の流れに｛うが／穿｝たれた｛くい／杭｝のよう
で、学生達が周りを通り過ぎていく。
dialogues.en:
I look at Suginami. We're standing like big stones that are
stuck in the river flow of other students passing by around
us.
dialogues.text:
I look at Suginami. We're standing like big stones that are
stuck in the river flow of other students passing by around
us.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「お前、“鶴の恩返し”の話は知っているか？」
dialogues.en: "Do you know a story called 'The Grateful Crane'?"
dialogues.text: "Do you know a story called 'The Grateful Crane'?"

dialogues.jp: こいつ、俺と同じ事を考えてやがる……。
dialogues.en: He's thinking about the same thing I thought about.
dialogues.text: He's thinking about the same thing I thought about.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、知ってるだろうな、普通は。つうと与
　ひょうだ。鶴を助けてやったら、恩を返しに
　来たってアレだ」
dialogues.en:
"Everybody knows the story, right? A guy helped a crane and
the crane comes back to do something nice in return for his
kindness."
dialogues.text:
"Everybody knows the story, right? A guy helped a crane and
the crane comes back to do something nice in return for his
kindness."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「さて、朝倉よ。似たような話、俺達もつい最
　近聞いたよな？」
dialogues.en:
"So, Asakura. We heard something like that recently, didn't
we?"
dialogues.text:
"So, Asakura. We heard something like that recently, didn't
we?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「まあ、そんな気はするな。ただ……」
dialogues.en: "Well, I think so. But......"
dialogues.text: "Well, I think so. But......"

dialogues.jp: ひょいっと肩をすくめてみせる。
dialogues.en: I shrug my shoulders.
dialogues.text: I shrug my shoulders.

dialogues.jp:
「その話で、与ひょうに当たる人物が誰なのか、
　それが分からないんだよな……」
dialogues.en:
"But I don't understand who's supposed to be the nice guy
who helped a crane."
dialogues.text:
"But I don't understand who's supposed to be the nice guy
who helped a crane."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「無論、お前だろう」
dialogues.en: "It's you of course."
dialogues.text: "It's you of course."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「しかしな、杉並。恩を売るなんてアナクロな
　行動、俺は取った覚えがないんだよな……」
dialogues.en:
"But Suginami, I don't remember doing anything kind to get
anything in return."
dialogues.text:
"But Suginami, I don't remember doing anything kind to get
anything in return."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「はっはっは！　お前って奴は、ほんとにいい
　奴だなあ！」
dialogues.en: "Ha-ha-ha! You really are a nice guy."
dialogues.text: "Ha-ha-ha! You really are a nice guy."

dialogues.jp:
何を思ったか、ばんばんと背中をぶったたいて
くる。背中もそうだが、通行人の｛いぶか／訝｝しげな視線
が、痛い。
dialogues.en:
All of a sudden, he slaps me hard on my back. It hurts my
back, but it's more uncomfortable to draw curious looks from
the passersby.
dialogues.text:
All of a sudden, he slaps me hard on my back. It hurts my
back, but it's more uncomfortable to draw curious looks from
the passersby.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「恩を恩とも思わずに、善行を積める奴なんざ
　そうそう居ないぞ。なんて見上げた奴だっ」
dialogues.en:
"There aren't many people who can do nice things without
knowing it. You make me proud, man!"
dialogues.text:
"There aren't many people who can do nice things without
knowing it. You make me proud, man!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「はっはっは！　友として鼻が高いぞ、朝倉！」
dialogues.en:
"Ha-ha-ha! I am so proud to have a friend like you,
Asakura!"
dialogues.text:
"Ha-ha-ha! I am so proud to have a friend like you,
Asakura!"

dialogues.jp: そういう事でもないんだけどね……。
dialogues.en: I don't think that's what's happening, though......
dialogues.text: I don't think that's what's happening, though......

dialogues.jp: ◆鶴の恩返し◆
dialogues.en: ◆Yoriko◆
dialogues.text: ◆Yoriko◆

dialogues.jp: 登校途中。杉並から一枚のチラシを見せられた。
dialogues.en: "You, too."
dialogues.text: "You, too."

dialogues.jp:
猫を探しています、と書いてあったそのチラシ、
その猫の名前は『頼子』
dialogues.en: "Well, off I go, then."
dialogues.text: "Well, off I go, then."

dialogues.jp:
偶然にしては出来すぎなようで、これは矢張り、
鶴の恩返しってやつなんだろうか？
dialogues.en:
I take a big breath, fill my lungs with the warm spring air,
and walk to school.
dialogues.text:
I take a big breath, fill my lungs with the warm spring air,
and walk to school.

dialogues.jp:
だが、恩返しされるような事なんて、まったく
思い当たらない俺だった……。
dialogues.en: "Hey, man! It's such a beautiful day, isn't it?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, man! It's such a beautiful day, isn't it?"
